description: Submitted by the employer every month (by the 25th) to register new employees who joined during that month under EPF Scheme.

fields.name: Name of Establishment
fields.description: Full registered name of the employer's establishment.

fields.name: Code Number
fields.description: EPFO code number of the establishment (allotted by EPFO regional office).

fields.name: Wage Month
fields.description: The month for which the return is being filed (e.g., March 2024).

fields.name: Account Number
fields.description: Assigned PF account number for the new employee.

fields.name: Employee Name
fields.description: Full name of the newly joined employee.

fields.name: Father's / Husband's Name
fields.description: Father's name for unmarried employees, husband's name for married female employees.

fields.name: Date of Birth
fields.description: Employee's date of birth in DD/MM/YYYY format.

fields.name: Sex
fields.description: Male / Female / Other — required for statistical and benefit purposes.

fields.name: Date of Joining the Fund
fields.description: Date on which the employee became eligible and was enrolled in EPFO.

fields.name: Previous PF Account Number
fields.description: If the employee has a previous PF account with another employer, enter the full account number.

fields.name: Remarks
fields.description: Any additional information like whether the employee had prior service history in another PF-covered organisation.

fields.name: Employer Signature & Seal
fields.description: Signature of the authorized employer representative with official stamp.
